posts.name: robb8888
posts.cooked:
Another TZL question:

 

I was playing a practice round in the Temple, getting ready for the weekly one-shot.  One of the Apprentice Poisoners was out, and Fixer hit her with the Hoist Chain, killing her.  On the card, her damage is not irreducible, so the Hoist Chain should have reduced the 1 HP damage she did on her death ...but it didn't.  She did the full 1 HP of damage to everyone.  Is this a bug, or is there something weird about the way the Poisoner works?
posts.raw:
Another TZL question:

 

I was playing a practice round in the Temple, getting ready for the weekly one-shot.  One of the Apprentice Poisoners was out, and Fixer hit her with the Hoist Chain, killing her.  On the card, her damage is not irreducible, so the Hoist Chain should have reduced the 1 HP damage she did on her death ...but it didn't.  She did the full 1 HP of damage to everyone.  Is this a bug, or is there something weird about the way the Poisoner works?

posts.name: just.a.smith
posts.cooked: I suspect what's happening is that Fixer hits Posioner -> Poisoner is destroyed -> Posioner triggers, dealing one to each non-environment target -> Debuff from Hoist Chain gets applied.  Whether or not this is intended behavior I'm uncertain.
posts.raw: I suspect what's happening is that Fixer hits Posioner -> Poisoner is destroyed -> Posioner triggers, dealing one to each non-environment target -> Debuff from Hoist Chain gets applied.  Whether or not this is intended behavior I'm uncertain.

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked: Actually that might be, if it is an “on destruction” effect, then the “when it takes damage” effect might not apply first (if at all).
posts.raw: Actually that might be, if it is an "on destruction" effect, then the "when it takes damage" effect might not apply first (if at all).

posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
It definitely shouldn’t. With similar targets (Ambuscade’s Mine) and effects (Throat Jab, Stun Bolts, etc.) it applies before it’s destroyed. Damage has to happen before destruction, because the damage CAUSED the destruction.

Has to be a bug.

posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
There is a difference in wording between Sonic Mine and Apprentice Poisoner.

Sonic Mine: When this card is destroyed, it deals each hero target 2 Sonic damage.

Apprentice Poisoner: When this card is destroyed, it first deals each non-environment target 1 Toxic damage.

 

I don't see how the inclusion of the word 'first' would change the order of events so that damage reduction works on one but not the other, though.

That is a really pedantic correction. The fact of the matter is, it has to take damage before it is destroyed, so any outside "when it takes damage" effects must trigger before ITS "when it's destroyed" text goes off. We aren't talking about Cryo Bot type effects here. Those are completely irrelevant.

The point is, Hypersonic has the EXACT same wording as Hoist chain. If Hypersonic works, then so should it.

I still say that it's a bug, or at least an error.
